title: Whole genome sequencing precision medicine strategy to shorten treatment for rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis (SMARTT): a pragmatic, randomised, single-blind phase 4 trial
impact: Demonstrates WGS- and AI-guided treatment with shorter treatment duration and favourable clinical outcomes in RR-TB care.

journal: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
title: A treatment recommender clinical decision support system for personalized medicine
impact: Develops a computational framework for recommending individualized drug-resistant TB treatments.

title: The DREstimator: automated interpretation of variants in candidate resistance genes in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
impact: Extends WGS drug-resistance interpretation to variants not classified in the WHO catalogue, supporting actionable clinical results.

title: The MAGMA pipeline for comprehensive genomic analyses of clinical Mycobacterium tuberculosis samples
impact: Introduces the MAGMA analysis pipeline for comprehensive TB whole-genome sequencing.

title: Exploring the potential of Oxford Nanopore Technologies sequencing for Mycobacterium tuberculosis sequencing
impact: Evaluates the performance and limitations of newer nanopore sequencing chemistry for TB.

title: Microfluidic Capture of Mycobacterium tuberculosis from Clinical Samples for Culture-Free Whole-Genome Sequencing
impact: Demonstrates microfluidic cell capture as an approach to culture-free TB whole-genome sequencing.

title: Detection of minor variants in Mycobacterium tuberculosis whole genome sequencing data
impact: Evaluates reliable detection of low-frequency variants in clinical TB sequencing data.

title: Variants in Bedaquiline-Candidate-Resistance Genes: Prevalence in Bedaquiline-Naive Patients, Effect on MIC, and Association with Mycobacterium tuberculosis Lineage
impact: Tests how candidate resistance variants relate to minimum inhibitory concentrations.

title: Bedaquiline resistance in patients with drug-resistant tuberculosis in Cape Town, South Africa
impact: Documents acquired and transmitted bedaquiline resistance in patients receiving programmatic care.
